implemented: Added train-time hard Brier auxiliary loss controlled by lambda_hard_brier.
Added train-time hard soft-F1 auxiliary loss controlled by lambda_hard_soft_f1.
Added evaluator hard F1@0.5 and temperature-scaled ECE/Brier fields.
Extended predictive autoresearch runner with calibration-loss and ASL gamma/clip sweep arguments.
Runner eval now includes --temperature-scale-hard so results.tsv can carry calibration guardrails.
interpretation: Temperature scaling shows meaningful SA0 calibration headroom.
SA1 remains poorly calibrated after temperature scaling, suggesting class-boundary or label-distribution issues.
Temperature scaling does not change F1@0.5 because the 0.5 sigmoid threshold is equivalent to logit >= 0 for any positive temperature.
The next training sweep should test lambda_hard_brier, lambda_hard_soft_f1, hard_asl_gamma_neg, and hard_asl_clip around the frozen mean/global/no-rank mainline.
